articles.title: Standard Chartered-led Anchorpoint launches Hong Kong dollar stablecoin
articles.snippet: HashKey Exchange and OSL Group are now authorized distributors, enabling institutional and professional investors to mint and redeem HKDAP tokens.

articles.title: Harmony’s ONE dives 40% after an attack appears to mint tokens equal to quarter of supply
articles.snippet: Harmony said in Asian morning hours it is working with exchanges to freeze funds and preparing a software fix.

articles.title: ARP Digital secures Dubai VARA broker-dealer license
articles.snippet: The license allows ARP Digital to offer regulated digital asset and stablecoin conversions into UAE dirhams as it expands its Gulf presence beyond Bahrain.

articles.title: Coinbase-backed Flowdesk secures full broker-dealer license in Dubai
articles.snippet: Flowdesk’s VARA approval follows its MiCA authorization in France as crypto firms build regulated operations across major global markets.

articles.title: Harmony's ONE Sinks 37% After Attacker Mints 4 Billion Tokens
articles.snippet: The team is weighing a rollback, which would undo the attack along with every legitimate transaction made since.
